name: PT Mulia Industrindo Tbk
summary: PT Mulia Industrindo Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells glass in Indonesia, Asia, Australia, Europe, Africa, and the United States. It operates through Float Glass, Safety Glass, Glass Containers and Glass Block segments. The company offers plain and colored float glass; mugs and cups, as well as transparent and colored container glass used for packaging of food, beverages, and beer; glass blocks; and automotive safety glasses for front/rear door right/left door, rear quarter left/right, back door window, and windshield.
